newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ says Ansett announcement imminent.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ says Ansett announcement imminent.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd Chairman Bob Matthew said on Monday an announcement would be made today or tomorrow on the airline's planned purchase of 50 percent of Ansett Australia from TNT Ltd.
Air NZ also said the impact of the planned purchase would be neutral in the current year to June 1997.
"In general terms our expectation is that in the first year or so the 50 percent interest in Ansett would be relatively neutral on our accounts," Matthew told a news briefing.

"That is to say, there would be some sort of balancing or matching between the interest earnings that we will forego when we pay. That will be countered somewhat by Ansett's own contribution and productivity enhancements that we will get from working closer together."
The news briefing was to have been held on Monday morning but was delayed in the hope that Air NZ would be able to make an announcement about Ansett.
